name: Advanced Network Diagnostics
description: Inspect IP configuration, local reachability, and DNS without changing network settings.

inspect_ip_configuration.title: Inspect the IP Configuration
inspect_ip_configuration.instruction: Open Command Prompt and run ipconfig /all. Check whether the active adapter has an IPv4 address, default gateway, and DNS servers.

check_ip_address.question: What kind of IPv4 address does the active adapter have?
check_ip_address.help_text: An address beginning with 169.254 usually indicates that the computer could not obtain an address from DHCP.

test_gateway.title: Test the Default Gateway
test_gateway.instruction: Run ping followed by the default gateway address shown in ipconfig /all.

test_dns.title: Test DNS Resolution
test_dns.instruction: Run nslookup example.com and confirm that a DNS server returns an address.

dns_result.question: Did nslookup return an IP address?

dhcp_problem.title: Possible DHCP Problem
dhcp_problem.message: The computer has an automatic private IP address. First verify the physical or Wi-Fi connection and whether DHCP is available. If policy allows a lease renewal, avoid doing it over the affected remote connection because releasing the address can disconnect the support session.

adapter_problem.title: Possible Adapter Problem
adapter_problem.message: The active adapter does not have an IPv4 address. Check whether the adapter is enabled, its driver is working, and the connection is active.

ip_configuration_unclear.title: IP Configuration Could Not Be Classified
ip_configuration_unclear.message: The IPv4 configuration could not be classified confidently. Record the active adapter's IPv4 address, subnet mask, default gateway, and DHCP status from ipconfig /all, then have a technician or network administrator review the values before changing network settings.

local_network_problem.title: Local Network Connectivity Problem
local_network_problem.message: The computer could not reach its default gateway. Check the adapter, cable or Wi-Fi connection, switch port, VLAN, and local network equipment.

dns_problem.title: DNS Resolution Problem
dns_problem.message: The computer can reach the local network, but DNS resolution failed. Record the configured DNS servers and query an organization-approved DNS server explicitly if one is available. Do not replace DNS settings without authorization.

advanced_complete.title: Core Network Diagnostics Passed
advanced_complete.message: The computer has a valid IP configuration, can reach the default gateway, and can resolve DNS names. Continue with browser, proxy, VPN, firewall, or application-specific troubleshooting if the issue remains.
